enum.doc: A cell with at least this much heat (a burning furnace's reach).

enum.name: Cold
enum.doc: A cell with at least this much cold (snow and ice beside it).

enum.name: Block
enum.doc: A cell holding this block.

enum.name: HeatedBlock
enum.doc:
A cell holding this block, with at least this much heat (a lit
furnace).

named.name: heat
named.doc: The heat the cell must reach.

enum.name: Runeforge
enum.doc:
A cell holding a forge stone, the core of a standing runeforge the
maker may use (RW3): the recipe's `MakeInfo::mana` comes from the
forge's nearest pool of that element.

types.name: ManaCost
types.doc:
The mana one make costs (`MakeInfo::mana`): made at a runeforge, taken
from its nearest pool of the element.

struct.name: amount
struct.doc: How much.

types.name: MakeLearn
types.doc: How a make recipe is learned (`MakeInfo.learn`; content's `"learn"`).

enum.name: Start
enum.doc: Every player knows it from the start.

enum.name: Holding
enum.doc:
Learned once the player has held each of these items at some point
(its key items: its parts less the commons, or content's list), in
id order.

enum.name: Taught
enum.doc:
Only taught: by a milestone (`MakeInfo.milestone`), a fruit
(`MakeInfo.teaser`) or a place.

types.name: TreeInfo
types.doc: A dryad tree (`ServerMsg::Trees`).

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Who planted it (each player plants one).

struct.name: name
struct.doc: Their name.

struct.name: heart
struct.doc: Its heart: the cell the seed was planted in, at the trunk's foot.

struct.name: stage
struct.doc: Its growth stage: 0 is the sapling.

struct.name: fruit
struct.doc: Which fruit have been eaten, a bit each (none yet).

struct.name: health
struct.doc: Its health when this was sent, 1 full (nothing lowers it yet).

struct.name: bars
struct.doc:
How much of each element's mana it has eaten toward its next
stage (fire, water, wind, earth), as lines from its last solve: a
bar rises at its rate while a pool on the heart's rune lines has
that mana, and never
past `full` (read it capped). Sent again when a bar's rate changes,
so a client tints the bark veins from these alone. The heart
panel's `tree` query has the rest.

struct.name: full
struct.doc: A full bar (the content's): it eats no more of its mana.

struct.name: greening
struct.doc:
How far it greens the land at its stage, in blocks across the
ground from the heart (0 for none): grass and leaves read greener
there, most at the heart and fading to nothing at this radius.

struct.name: apart
struct.doc:
How near this connection's player may plant its seed to this
heart, in blocks across the ground (W3T): `hearts_apart` if the
owner trusts it, `strangers_apart` if not, 0 for its own tree. Sent
again when a trust changes, so the compass reads "too near wren's
tree" where a plant would be refused.

types.name: LinearAmount
types.doc:
An amount that changes linearly: `value + rate × (t − at)` at world time
`t`, exactly, on the fixed-point bits. Whole items are its floor.

struct.name: at
struct.doc: The time `value` was measured at.

struct.name: value
struct.doc: The amount at `at`.

struct.name: rate
struct.doc: Change per step.

types.name: HuntEvent
types.doc: What a hunt or a feed did (`ServerMsg::Hunt`).

enum.name: Hit
enum.doc:
The blow hurt her (`left` health), or glanced off (`left` as it
was, `hurt` false): her herd is alarmed either way.

named.name: hurt
named.doc:
False if the blow was too weak for her (its `hit` at most her
`tough`).

enum.name: Killed
enum.doc:
She fell: her drops lie as piles where she did, and her herd is a
member short until `back` (world time).

named.name: back
named.doc: When her herd has her back.

enum.name: Fed
enum.doc: She took the food: her trust is the feeds she has taken.

enum.name: Tamed
enum.doc:
She took the food and is tame: she left her herd (her `Creature`
entity goes) and follows the player as a `Kept` one.

named.name: entity
named.doc: Her entity as she was, in her herd.

enum.name: Lured
enum.doc: Her strayed kin took the food and follows her owner again (KN1).

types.name: HomeEvent
types.doc: What a home command did (`ServerMsg::Home`).

enum.name: Homed
enum.doc: Kept creatures were homed at `home`: they live and graze there now.

named.name: entities
named.doc: Their entities in the stream, in the order homed.

enum.name: Provisioned
enum.doc: The home was fed.

named.name: fed_until
named.doc: When its feed runs out now (world time).

enum.name: Collected
enum.doc: What it had made was taken.

types.name: FightEvent
types.doc: What happened in a fight (`ServerMsg::Fight`).

enum.name: Husk
enum.doc:
A husk as it is now: sent when it stands up, when its phase
changes, and when a body comes within range of it.

enum.name: Gone
enum.doc: A husk went (cleared, or out of range: no more news of it).

enum.name: Tell
enum.doc:
A husk began its wind-up at a body: its strike lands at `lands`
(world time). Dodge from then until two steps after.

enum.name: Hit
enum.doc: A swing hit a husk.

named.name: stagger
named.doc: The blow staggered its wind-up (its strike is lost).

enum.name: Struck
enum.doc: A husk's strike hurt a body (its `Vitals` follow).

enum.name: Dodged
enum.doc: A body dodged a husk's strike.

enum.name: Down
enum.doc: A husk went down.

enum.name: Cast
enum.doc:
A body cast a charm (`Command::Charm`): the `hits` `Hit`s that
follow are its, not a swing's. Sent to whoever sees the first husk
it hit, or to the caster alone for a charm on itself.

enum.name: Warded
enum.doc:
A ward took some of a husk's strike (a `Struck` follows for the
rest, if any).

enum.name: Course
enum.doc:
A husk's course changed (FR2): from step `at` it stood at `pos`
and moves `vx`, `vz` units (1/4096 block) a step, facing `yaw`,
until the next `Course` or `Husk`; its feet follow the ground. A
client draws it at `pos + vel × (now - at)`, smoothed. A husk sets
a course at most every 7 steps unless its wind-up, strike, stagger
or the ground stops it.

named.name: at
named.doc: The step (world time) it stood at `pos`.

named.name: vx
named.doc: Units it moves a step along x.

named.name: vz
named.doc: Units it moves a step along z.

enum.name: Companion
enum.doc:
A player's companion as it is now (FR4: the stand-in fox): from
step `at` it stood at `pos` and moves `vx`, `vz` units a step
(as a `Course`), to the run's members. Sent when it sets out,
stops, turns or changes speed, and when its state changes; a new
course on the last one's line, at its speed and facing, sends none
(a client goes on extrapolating it); `gone` when it leaves the room.

named.name: at
named.doc: The step (world time) it stood at `pos`.

named.name: vx
named.doc: Units it moves a step along x.

named.name: vz
named.doc: Units it moves a step along z.

named.name: winded_until
named.doc: Struck: it can't harry until this step (world time; 0: not).

named.name: ready_at
named.doc: It can harry again at this step (world time; 0: now).

named.name: gone
named.doc: It left the room (its owner is out).

named.name: kin
named.doc:
The kin this is (KN3: a companion of its owner's party, drawn
as her species); `None` for the shrine's stand-in fox, which
comes with a member who has none.

enum.name: Harried
enum.doc: A companion harried a husk: its wind-up, if any, is staggered.

enum.name: Cleansed
enum.doc:
A player's cleanse freed a weakened husked native (KN2): it is
gone from the fight (its `Gone` follows), its native kin again.

named.name: species
named.doc:
The native kin it is again (an index into
`ContentInfo.creatures`).

named.name: herd
named.doc:
The kin's herd, bonded to `by` (a kept creature, member 0, that
the creature stream shows as his), its low 53 bits as
`Creature::herd`; `None` if she went free.

enum.name: KinWord
enum.doc:
A companion's active word (KN3), to its owner and, in a Spire
run, the run's members: once as she starts its tell (`fired`
false: she stops and gathers until `fires_at`), and once as it
fires (`fired` true, with what it did).

named.name: fires_at
named.doc: The step it fires at (world time).

named.name: ready_at
named.doc: The step she may say it again (world time).

named.name: damage
named.doc: Its harm to each husk on it.

enum.name: CompanionCourse
enum.doc:
A run member's companion's new course (NK1), the lean twin of a
`Companion` frame: from step `at` it stood at `pos` and moves `vx`,
`vz` units a step, facing `yaw`. Its state (winded, ready, its
`CompanionKin`) is as the last `Companion` for it said, which
always comes first: a state change is a `Companion`. Its owner gets
each one as it is set; the run's other members get the latest of
them at most 5 times a second (a course they already foresee, none).

named.name: index
named.doc:
Its place in its owner's party (`CompanionKin::index`; the
fox's 0).

named.name: at
named.doc: The step (world time) it stood at `pos`.

named.name: vx
named.doc: Units it moves a step along x.

named.name: vz
named.doc: Units it moves a step along z.

enum.name: Zone
enum.doc:
A director put a zone on the ground (P6.1d; rev 12's
`FightInput::Zone`): it lands at `lands` (world time) and is
judged two steps after, then goes. It holds its fight's `slot`
(0 to 7) until then; a later zone in the same slot replaces it.
Sent to every member of the room's fight (zones are no husk's).

named.name: slot
named.doc: Its slot in the fight (0 to 7).

named.name: id
named.doc:
Its group: a `Shelter` and the `Lee`s that cover from it share
one.

named.name: pos
named.doc:
Its anchor (where it was put, or its body's feet as it was
put).

named.name: on
named.doc: The body it follows to its landing, if any.

named.name: reach
named.doc: An arc's or a ring's radius, a line's length, 1/4096 block.

enum.name: Marked
enum.doc:
A husk hunts one body until `until` (P6.1d; rev 12's
`FightInput::Fix`): its strikes and its walk go for that body.
`body` 0 clears it.

enum.name: Broken
enum.doc:
A husk's ordered wind-up broke under enough blows (P6.1d): it
reels, its strike lost.

enum.name: Unzoned
enum.doc:
The zone in `slot` went unjudged (R14; fight rules rev 14's
`FightInput::Unzone`): its stage changed, or its boss fell. It
lands on no one; forget it. Sent to every member of the room's
fight, as `Zone` is.

named.name: slot
named.doc: Its slot in the fight (0 to 7).

types.name: HuskView
types.doc: A husk as a client draws it (`FightEvent::Husk`).

struct.name: entity
struct.doc: Its entity id: [`HUSK_ENTITY_BASE`] up.

struct.name: kind
struct.doc:
Its content kind (an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`), or
`None` for the training dummy.

struct.name: pos
struct.doc: Its feet.

struct.name: yaw
struct.doc: Its facing, 1/256 of a turn.

struct.name: phase
struct.doc: What it is doing.

struct.name: health
struct.doc: Its health.

struct.name: max
struct.doc: Its full health.

struct.name: lands
struct.doc:
When its strike lands (world time), while it winds up or strikes;
while it is weakened (KN2), when it slips away uncleansed.

struct.name: strike
struct.doc:
The strike it winds up or strikes (P6.1d): 0 its kind's own, `k`
its species' move `k` (`CreatureFight.moves[k - 1]`).

struct.name: blows
struct.doc:
Blows landed on its wind-up so far (P6.1d), while that wind-up
breaks after several (the move's `breaks`); else 0.

types.name: HuskPhase
types.doc: What a husk is doing (`FightEvent::Husk`).

enum.name: Idle
enum.doc: Waiting.

enum.name: Wind
enum.doc: Winding up its strike: the tell. It lands at `HuskView::lands`.

enum.name: Strike
enum.doc: Striking.

enum.name: Recover
enum.doc: Recovering after a strike.

enum.name: Staggered
enum.doc: Staggered by a blow in its wind-up.

enum.name: Down
enum.doc: Down at 0 health; it stands up whole.

enum.name: Weakened
enum.doc:
A husked native at 0 health (KN2): it lies weakened, struck by
nothing, until a cleanse frees it or it slips away (`Gone`).

types.name: CompanionKin
types.doc: The kin a `FightEvent::Companion` is (KN3).

struct.name: index
struct.doc: Her place in her owner's party, 0 to 2.

struct.name: herd
struct.doc: Her herd (as `EntityKind::Kept::herd`).

struct.name: member
struct.doc: Her place in it.

struct.name: species
struct.doc: Her species (an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`).

struct.name: word
struct.doc: Her active word's name for players (the kit's button).

struct.name: full
struct.doc: Her bond is full: drawn in her cosmetic's look.

struct.name: hits
struct.doc: Strikes she has taken this room (three knock her out).

struct.name: out
struct.doc: Knocked out (with `gone`): she went home to rest.

struct.name: role
struct.doc:
Her place in the Tidemother's raid (P5.3b): 0 none (not placed,
or out), 1 hold (the far maw), 2 guard (the drowners), 3 draw (her
jet), 4 holding (a hold waiting off the far maw: the chip's pulse).

types.name: RunEvent
types.doc: What a player's Spire run did (`ServerMsg::Run`).

enum.name: Descend
enum.doc:
The player is in run `run`: sent as its party goes down (before
the `PlayerState` that puts its body in the antechamber), and on
connecting while it is still in it (the reconnect window). The
client fades to roots, asks for a 4/2 view, and shows the kit.

named.name: title
named.doc: The room's rule line ("The root hall").

named.name: waves
named.doc: The room's waves for this party.

named.name: bag
named.doc: The player's bag: what it has found and not banked.

enum.name: Phase
enum.doc: The room moved on: a gate shut, a wave stood up or went down.

enum.name: Found
enum.doc: A wave went down: `player` found `count` of `item` (into its bag).

enum.name: Out
enum.doc:
The player is out of the run, its bag lost: knocked out, recalled,
or away past the 60 s reconnect window. It wakes by the shrine
(its `PlayerState` follows); the party fights on.

enum.name: Closed
enum.doc:
The run closed with the player in it (or, `restart`, while it
slept: sent on connecting). `banked` went into its inventory, and
its body is by the shrine (a `PlayerState` follows). `left` and
`wiped` go to the whole party once the last member is out (each
was told its own `Out` already): nothing banked, no body moved.

named.name: relics
named.doc:
The relics it banked, each with its grade and where it came
from (RW): the camp's first, then a second, then its bag's.

enum.name: Floor
enum.doc:
The run is a floor's (SP2): sent after `Descend`, and again on
connecting in it. Its card, its rules and its plan's rooms.

named.name: card_text
named.doc: What the card does, in a line.

named.name: rooms
named.doc: The plan's rooms, by index (`RunEvent::Rooms` masks).

named.name: seals
named.doc:
The seals its opener set at the door (P5.5): each one's card,
after the floor's, for everyone in the run (`rules` folds
them in).

enum.name: Rooms
enum.doc:
How the floor stands (SP2), to the run's members whenever it
changes: which rooms show, which were walked into and cleared, the
room being fought, the test and the flood.

named.name: cleared
named.doc: The fight and test rooms cleared.

named.name: room
named.doc: The room being fought or waited in.

named.name: test
named.doc: The test, once its room is walked into.

named.name: flood
named.doc: The room flooding, if one is.

enum.name: Stolen
enum.doc:
A wave down won back `amount` of an element's mana (SP2), banked
into the player's pools at the camp (or on a restart).

named.name: element
named.doc: Its element: 0 fire, 1 water, 2 wind, 3 earth.

enum.name: Passed
enum.doc: The floor's test passed (SP2): the player has its camp.

enum.name: Mana
enum.doc:
What the player's won-back mana did as the run closed (SP2), just
before its `Closed`: by element (fire, water, wind, earth), banked
into its own pools, and lost (no pool of that element of its own,
or no room).

named.name: owned
named.doc:
Whether the player owns a pool of each element (on its land,
`World::pools_owned`), so the client can say why mana was lost:
none of its own, or no room in those it has.

enum.name: Trial
enum.doc:
The floor's test as it stands (SP2b): after `Floor`, and again
whenever the wellspring, the riddle's sockets or its last try
change. What it asks, in one line, is shown on walking into the
test room.

named.name: asks
named.doc: What the test asks, in one line.

named.name: spring
named.doc: The wellspring, if the floor has one.

named.name: sockets
named.doc: The riddle's sockets (empty: no riddle, or its room not shown).

named.name: standing
named.doc: Whether the riddle's frame stands whole of stone.

named.name: failed
named.doc: It failed for this run (the escort lost): the camp stays shut.

enum.name: Escort
enum.doc:
The escort (SP2b): a frightened creature that must reach the camp
alive. Sent as she waits, whenever her course or health changes,
and as she is lost or home (`gone`). A course, like a companion's.

named.name: at
named.doc: The step (world time) she stood at `pos`.

named.name: vx
named.doc: Units she moves a step along x.

named.name: vz
named.doc: Units she moves a step along z.

named.name: hunter
named.doc:
The husk going for her, by species (`forge:lunger`), while one
is: winding up at her, or near her since its blow at her (N2).

named.name: gone
named.doc: She is gone: lost, or home.

enum.name: Guardian
enum.doc:
The floor's guardian as she stands (SP5): sent as she stands up,
at each phase, when her maws change, and as her health changes, at
most 4 times a second.

named.name: health
named.doc: Her health, exact (a husk's view scales it to a byte).

named.name: max
named.doc: Her full health: her health for each member, times them.

named.name: members
named.doc: The members she was stood up for.

named.name: maws
named.doc: Her maws standing, in the flood (0 to 2).

named.name: maw_back_ms
named.doc:
In the flood, with one maw down alone: how long until it rises
again (ms). Both must fall within the window.

named.name: stage
named.doc:
Her stage (P6.1d), from 0, into the stage list her opening
`GuardianSays` brought; `stages` once she is felled.

named.name: stages
named.doc: Her stages (P6.1d): the stage list's length.

named.name: heat
named.doc:
Her heat (P6.1d, 0 to 255): how hard her director presses now;
0 while no director runs her.

enum.name: GuardianSays
enum.doc:
The guardian's words (SP5): as she stands up (with the banner) and
at each phase, to her run's members (and a member back mid-fight).

named.name: banner
named.doc:
As she stands up, what the fight asks (the HUD's banner for a
few seconds); empty after.

named.name: line
named.doc: Her phase's line, under her bar until the next.

named.name: stages
named.doc:
Her stages in order (P6.1d), sent whole once: as she stands up
and to a member back mid-fight; empty at each later stage.

named.name: words
named.doc:
A boss's own words for its fight (BP), sent with its stages
when its encounter has them; none: the client's own (the
Tidemother's).

enum.name: Outside
enum.doc:
Who holds the gate open (FX3a): while the room waits for its party,
the members here not in it yet, by name, as that changes (empty once
all are in or the gate shut). The gate shuts on whoever is in 30 s
after the first walked in; the rest are let in late.

types.name: RunFind
types.doc: Some of an item, found in a run (`RunEvent`).

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The item.

struct.name: count
struct.doc: How many.

types.name: RoomPhase
types.doc: Where a Spire room is (`RunEvent`).

enum.name: Waiting
enum.doc:
The party gathers in the antechamber; its gate shuts once all are
in the hall.

named.name: shut
named.doc: The gate shut: the first wave is about to stand up.

enum.name: Fighting
enum.doc: Wave `wave` (from 0) of `of` is up.

enum.name: Between
enum.doc: Wave `wave` stands up soon (the one before it is down).

enum.name: Cleared
enum.doc: Every wave is down: the camp door is open.

types.name: RunOut
types.doc: Why a player is out of its run (`RunEvent::Out`).

enum.name: KnockedOut
enum.doc: Knocked out.

enum.name: Recalled
enum.doc: It recalled.

enum.name: Away
enum.doc: Away past the reconnect window.

types.name: RunClose
types.doc: How a run ended (`RunEvent::Closed`).

enum.name: Cleared
enum.doc: Through the camp door: bags and the relic banked.

enum.name: Restart
enum.doc:
The world stopped with it open: bags banked ("the Spire's doors
closed while the world slept").

enum.name: Left
enum.doc:
The last member still in left it (recalled, or away past the
window): nothing banked.

enum.name: Wiped
enum.doc: The last member still in was knocked out: nothing banked.

types.name: RunRelic
types.doc: A relic a run's close banked (`RunEvent::Closed`, RW).

struct.name: item
struct.doc: Its kind (an item).

struct.name: quality
struct.doc: Its quality: 0 cracked, 1 worn, 2 whole.

struct.name: from
struct.doc: Where it came from.

types.name: RelicFrom
types.doc: Where a banked relic came from (`RunRelic`, RW).

enum.name: Camp
enum.doc: The camp's: every cleared run banks one.

enum.name: Second
enum.doc: A second from the camp: a party of four's, a seal's.

enum.name: Hers
enum.doc:
A second from her chamber (floor 4): anyone's sometimes, a four's
and a seal's more often.

enum.name: Side
enum.doc: Found in a side room (its bag's).

enum.name: Test
enum.doc: Found in the test room, a wave's (its bag's).

enum.name: Floor
enum.doc: Found on the floor, its room not kept (a restart's close).

enum.name: Boss
enum.doc: A floor boss's, felled in its boss room (its bag's, P6.1e).

types.name: RunRules
types.doc:
What a floor's cards change (`RunEvent::Floor`, SP2): the parts a
client draws or predicts.

struct.name: jump
struct.doc: Whether a jump lifts (movement predicts it).

struct.name: glide
struct.doc: Whether a held glider glides.

struct.name: fall_scale
struct.doc: Fall harm, percent.

struct.name: light
struct.doc: The rooms' ambient light, 0 (none) to 15, if a card sets it.

struct.name: word_cost
struct.doc: Word costs by element (fire, water, wind, earth), percent.

struct.name: word_reach
struct.doc: Word reach by element, percent.

struct.name: flood
struct.doc: The rooms' flood, if they flood.

types.name: FloodRule
types.doc: How a floor's fight and test rooms flood (`RunRules`).

struct.name: start_ms
struct.doc: Milliseconds from a room's entry to its first block of water.

struct.name: every_ms
struct.doc: Milliseconds between rises.

struct.name: top
struct.doc: The deepest it gets, blocks above the floor.

types.name: FloorRoom
types.doc: A room of a floor's plan (`RunEvent::Floor`): its inside's box.

struct.name: kind
struct.doc: What it is.

struct.name: x
struct.doc:
Its inside's lowest corner, in world blocks (its floor is the
block below).

struct.name: size
struct.doc: Its inside's size across (square) and height.

types.name: FloorRoomKind
types.doc: What a planned room is (`FloorRoom`).

enum.name: Entry
enum.doc: Where the party lands.

enum.name: Fight
enum.doc: Waves of husks.

enum.name: Test
enum.doc: The floor's test (SP2: the `clear` test, waves to clear).

enum.name: Camp
enum.doc: The camp: walking in clears the floor.

enum.name: Side
enum.doc: Off the path: a find for walking in.

enum.name: Boss
enum.doc:
The floor's boss room (phase 6, P6.4a): its last fight room's
place. Until its boss stands in it (P6.1e) it wakes a fight room's
waves.

types.name: SealCard
types.doc: A seal's card in a run (`RunEvent::Floor`, P5.5).

struct.name: card
struct.doc: The card's title ("Brittle").

struct.name: card_text
struct.doc: What it does, in a line.

types.name: TestProgress
types.doc: A floor's test as it stands (`RunEvent::Rooms`).

enum.name: Clear
enum.doc: Clear the room: `done` of `of` waves down.

enum.name: Frame
enum.doc: Set a riddle's frame right (SP2b): `solved` once it acted.

enum.name: Escort
enum.doc: Bring the escort to the camp alive (SP2b).

named.name: lost
named.doc: She was lost: the camp stays shut this run.

types.name: FloodNow
types.doc: The room flooding now (`RunEvent::Rooms`).

struct.name: room
struct.doc: The room.

struct.name: depth
struct.doc: Blocks deep now.

struct.name: next_ms
struct.doc: Milliseconds to the next rise, if it rises again.

types.name: Wellspring
types.doc:
A floor's wellspring (`RunEvent::Trial`, SP2b): the spring in its
entry room that holds the floor's element mana for the frames laid in
the run, shown like a pool.

struct.name: x
struct.doc: Its block.

struct.name: element
struct.doc: Its element: 0 fire, 1 water, 2 wind, 3 earth.

struct.name: amount
struct.doc: Its mana now.

struct.name: cap
struct.doc: Its most.

struct.name: cost
struct.doc: What a try of the riddle draws (0: no riddle).

types.name: TrialSocket
types.doc: A socket of a riddle's frame (`RunEvent::Trial`).

struct.name: x
struct.doc: Its block.

struct.name: word
struct.doc: The word it holds, by name in `words.json` (none: blank).

types.name: TrialSaid
types.doc: What a riddle's last try said, and why, in a player's words.

struct.name: text
struct.doc: One line ("burn fizzled: a ward takes no burn").

types.name: TrialSaidKind
types.doc: What a riddle's last try said (`RunEvent::Trial`).

enum.name: Pass
enum.doc: It read what the riddle wants: the frame acted.

enum.name: Fizzled
enum.doc: A word fizzled.

enum.name: Reads
enum.doc: It read whole, but not what the riddle wants.

enum.name: Spring
enum.doc: It would draw an element the wellspring doesn't hold.

enum.name: Low
enum.doc: The wellspring is too low for a try; it tries again as it fills.

types.name: GuardianStage
types.doc: A guardian's phase (`RunEvent::Guardian`, SP5).

enum.name: Coil
enum.doc: She coils and slams: strike her down to the flood.

enum.name: Flood
enum.doc: She sinks under her ward: fell both maws within the window.

enum.name: Drowning
enum.doc: She rises unwarded and drowns the room: fell her.

enum.name: Felled
enum.doc: She fell.

types.name: StageInfo
types.doc:
One stage of a boss fight (P6.1d; `RunEvent::GuardianSays.stages`):
what the HUD's bar, moment and light read for it.

struct.name: name
struct.doc: Its name, lower case ("the coil"): the bar's line.

struct.name: title
struct.doc: Its title ("The coil"): the moment's words over the view.

struct.name: start
struct.doc:
Her health as it starts, permille of her full health (the bar's
notch; 1000 for the first).

struct.name: hue
struct.doc: Its hue: the key into the client's stage lights.

struct.name: sting
struct.doc: Its sting: the key into the client's stage stings.

types.name: BossWords
types.doc:
A boss's own words for its fight (BP; `RunEvent::GuardianSays.words`,
the encounter's `words`): what the HUD's role call and bar say.

struct.name: hold
struct.doc: What a placed Hold does, after its name ("takes the far cover").

struct.name: guard
struct.doc: What a placed Guard does ("keeps the stones off you").

struct.name: draw
struct.doc: What a placed Draw does ("draws its throw").

struct.name: down
struct.doc: What follows "<companion> is down." ("The Bookends weaken.").

struct.name: guard_one
struct.doc: Its ward's guard, one ("cover"); empty: it has none.

struct.name: guards
struct.doc: Its ward's guards, more than one ("covers"); empty: it has none.

types.name: FloorDoor
types.doc: A floor as the root door lists it (`ServerMsg::Floors`, SP2).

struct.name: number
struct.doc: Its number, from 1.

struct.name: name
struct.doc: Its name ("the Sluices").

struct.name: card
struct.doc: Its rule card's title ("Drowned").

struct.name: card_text
struct.doc: What the card does, in a line.

struct.name: least
struct.doc:
The fewest that go down together (SP5: 4 for a guardian's floor,
else 1).

struct.name: most
struct.doc:
The most that go down together (SP5: 8 for a guardian's floor,
else 4).

types.name: SealDoor
types.doc:
A seal as the root door lists it (`ServerMsg::Floors`, P5.5): set
beside a floor's key, it adds its card to the run.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The seal item.

struct.name: card
struct.doc: Its card's title ("Brittle").

struct.name: card_text
struct.doc: What the card does, in a line.

struct.name: held
struct.doc: How many this player holds.

types.name: GuideFind
types.doc:
One find in the field guide (KN4): the first to tame (or breed) a
species' birthplace variant, credited by name.

struct.name: species
struct.doc: The species: an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`.

struct.name: birthplace
struct.doc: Its variant: an index into the species' `birthplaces`.

struct.name: by
struct.doc: Who found it first: their name.

struct.name: at
struct.doc: When (the world's step).

types.name: SlotView
types.doc: One non-empty inventory slot; inventories key them by slot index.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The item.

struct.name: count
struct.doc: How many.

types.name: StorageView
types.doc:
A storage's contents. Valid from the time it was sent until the next
`Update`: between events, amounts change only along their lines.

struct.name: capacity
struct.doc: Items it holds, all kinds together.

struct.name: items
struct.doc: Each item's amount; items with nothing and no flow are left out.

struct.name: full_at
struct.doc: The first step at which the total reaches capacity at current rates.

struct.name: empty_at
struct.doc: The first step at which each shrinking item reaches zero.

types.name: MachineView
types.doc:
A machine's state: a well (a windmill and a waterwheel are big ones), a
furnace, a crucible, a dryad heart.

struct.name: block
struct.doc: The machine's block.

struct.name: status
struct.doc: What it is doing.

struct.name: spin
struct.doc:
How fast its rotor turns, in revolutions per minute: a big well's
rated speed times its draw's factor; 0 for everything else, and
for a big well that doesn't draw. Constant until its status changes,
so a client turns it as a linear timeline.

types.name: MachineStatus
types.doc: What a machine is doing.

enum.name: Running
enum.doc: Working.

enum.name: Idle
enum.doc: Nothing to do.

enum.name: Stalled
enum.doc: Can't work.

types.name: StallCause
types.doc: Why a vessel, furnace, well or frame can't work.

enum.name: NoPower
enum.doc:
Retired (Q4: power left with the machinery); its tag is never sent
again.

enum.name: OutputBlocked
enum.doc: The storage it fills is full.

enum.name: NoInput
enum.doc: The storage it draws from is empty.

enum.name: Incomplete
enum.doc: A part is missing: no output path, no soil, nothing to fell.

enum.name: Unrecorded
enum.doc:
Retired (Q4: recorded contraptions left); its tag is never sent
again.

enum.name: Jammed
enum.doc: Retired (Q4: gear networks left); its tag is never sent again.

enum.name: NoHeat
enum.doc: The heat at its position is below what it needs (a crucible).

enum.name: NoCold
enum.doc: The cold at its position is below what it needs (a cold cellar).

enum.name: NoCurrent
enum.doc:
The current through it is below what it needs: no water runs
through a river jar.

enum.name: NoWind
enum.doc:
The wind on it is below what it needs: a wind cloth set too low or
sheltered.

enum.name: NotBuried
enum.doc:
The earth around it is below what it needs: a soil pot not buried
enough.

enum.name: Blighted
enum.doc:
It stands in the Spire's blight, where the land gives nothing: a
well there draws no mana.

enum.name: NotNow
enum.doc:
A rune frame's when doesn't hold: *at night* by day, or *when full*
while its pool isn't full.

types.name: Stats
types.doc: Engine counters for tests and diagnostics.

struct.name: world_time
struct.doc: World time.

struct.name: version
struct.doc: World version.

struct.name: events_fired
struct.doc:
Scheduled events fired since the server opened the world (opening
replays the log, and those count too).

struct.name: pending_events
struct.doc: Scheduled events waiting to fire.

struct.name: watched_chunks
struct.doc: Chunks in the watched set (near present players).

struct.name: entities
struct.doc: Live entities in the world.

struct.name: live_ticks
struct.doc:
Live steps run since the server opened the world; it stays put
while no factory runs live and no entity exists.

struct.name: storage_events_fired
struct.doc: The storage full and empty events among `events_fired`.

types.name: BasinView
types.doc:
A basin of water: a level over a body of cells. Valid until the next
`Update`: between events the level and volume change only along their
lines, so a client draws the surface rising with no per-step traffic.

struct.name: id
struct.doc: Its id: the smallest cell of its lowest layer.

struct.name: bottom
struct.doc: Its lowest layer's height.

struct.name: level
struct.doc:
The surface level in blocks (a cell at height `y` is water while
`y` is below it). Exact at `at`; `rate` is floored within the
current layer, and the next event re-sends it.

struct.name: volume
struct.doc: The water it holds, in blocks, exactly.

struct.name: rim
struct.doc: The level it spills at, if it has a rim.

struct.name: capacity
struct.doc: The volume at its rim.

struct.name: mode
struct.doc: Filling, spilling, or draining.

struct.name: inflow
struct.doc: Water flowing in per step.

struct.name: outflow
struct.doc: Water flowing out per step.

struct.name: next_event
struct.doc: Its next event (its level crossing a layer, reaching its rim).

struct.name: spill
struct.doc: The cell its overflow leaves from.

types.name: BasinMode
types.doc: What a basin is doing.

enum.name: Filling
enum.doc: Below its rim: rising with its inflow, nothing flows out.

enum.name: Spilling
enum.doc: At its rim: what flows in flows out; the level holds.

enum.name: Draining
enum.doc: Above its rim (after an edit opened an outlet): draining.

types.name: FluidCell
types.doc: Derived water in one cell.

struct.name: water
struct.doc: The cell holds water now (a basin, a stream, or a river channel).

struct.name: flow
struct.doc: Flow through it per step, in blocks (zero for still water).

struct.name: direction
struct.doc: Which way it flows, if it does.

struct.name: basin
struct.doc: The basin whose body holds it, if any.

struct.name: river
struct.doc: It is a converted river's channel.

types.name: FluidTotals
types.doc: The world's water balance: stored + exited = sourced + adopted, exactly.

struct.name: at
struct.doc: World time these are measured at.

struct.name: stored
struct.doc: Water held in basins.

struct.name: exited
struct.doc: Water that left (sea, rivers, soaking) since the world began.

struct.name: sourced
struct.doc: Water springs and rivers supplied since the world began.

struct.name: adopted
struct.doc: Water adopted from converted rivers' full pits.

struct.name: basins
struct.doc: How many basins exist.

types.name: WeatherAtView
types.doc:
The server's weather at a column (the `weather_at` query): what
`forge_core::weather` gives at its surface now, for checking clients
against. Each value is 65,536 full.

struct.name: time
struct.doc: The world time it is for.

struct.name: temperature
struct.doc: The column's climate, as the weather read it.

types.name: SatchelView
types.doc:
One of a player's satchels (the `satchels` query): a pile only its owner
takes, left where its body was knocked out.

struct.name: cell
struct.doc: The cell it lies in.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The item.

struct.name: count
struct.doc: How many.

types.name: WreckView
types.doc:
The wreck (the `wreck` query, L3): where it lies by the crash site, and
the asking player's share of its salvage.

struct.name: site
struct.doc: The crash site (as the `crash_site` query).

struct.name: spot
struct.doc:
The spot round the site it lies at (`0..24`): heading `spot % 8`
(an eighth of a turn each), distance `spot / 8`.

struct.name: at
struct.doc: The cell over the ground under its middle.

struct.name: salvage
struct.doc: Whether using it salvages (the content says what it gives).

struct.name: pulls
struct.doc: The player's pulls taken in all.

struct.name: left
struct.doc:
The pulls the player may still take today (0 till the next game
day once the share is taken).

types.name: KeptHomeView
types.doc:
A creature home as its inspector shows it (the `kept_home` query): who
lives there, and what it makes and when, compiled.

struct.name: species
struct.doc: The species kept: an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`.

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Whose it is.

struct.name: owner_name
struct.doc: Their name.

struct.name: fit
struct.doc:
How well the place suits the species, 0 to 1 (its niche): the rate
of everything it makes scales with it.

struct.name: capacity
struct.doc: The most it holds, young included.

struct.name: kept
struct.doc: Who lives there, in herd order.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: What each grown one gives; null for companions, which give nothing.

struct.name: stock
struct.doc: Made and waiting to be collected.

struct.name: stock_cap
struct.doc: The most it keeps waiting; it makes nothing more while full.

struct.name: fed_until
struct.doc: When its feed runs out (world time); null if unfed.

struct.name: stalled
struct.doc: Why it makes nothing now, if it doesn't (null for a companion's).

struct.name: next_product
struct.doc:
When the next product is ready (world time), if before the feed
runs out.

struct.name: next_birth
struct.doc:
When the next young one is born (world time), if before the feed
runs out.

struct.name: no_birth
struct.doc: Why no young one is coming, if none is.

struct.name: born
struct.doc: Young born there so far.

struct.name: contentment
struct.doc:
How content its creatures are, 0 to 1 (KN1): the share of a full
rate a hearth's creatures make (its fit, halved if crowded, halved
if the hearth's element isn't their nature); 0 while unfed.

struct.name: sours
struct.doc: Why its kin sulk (empty: content, or not kin).

struct.name: strays_at
struct.doc:
When one of its kin strays (world time), if it keeps them out of
place or crowded.

struct.name: room
struct.doc:
How many live there content (KN1: its species' room; its capacity
where the species gives none).

types.name: HomeKept
types.doc: One creature living at a home.

struct.name: herd
struct.doc: Her herd (as `EntityKind::Kept::herd`).

struct.name: member
struct.doc: Her place in it.

struct.name: grows
struct.doc: When she grows up (world time), if she is young.

types.name: HomeStall
types.doc: Why a home makes nothing.

enum.name: Unfed
enum.doc: Nothing to eat: feed it.

enum.name: Full
enum.doc: Its stock is full: collect.

types.name: HomeNoBirth
types.doc: Why a home breeds nothing.

enum.name: Never
enum.doc: Its species doesn't breed.

enum.name: Alone
enum.doc: Fewer than two grown ones.

enum.name: Crowded
enum.doc: No room: it holds its capacity.

enum.name: Unfed
enum.doc: Nothing to eat.

types.name: HomeSour
types.doc: Why a kin home's kin sulk (KN1).

enum.name: Unfed
enum.doc: Nothing to eat.

enum.name: Crowded
enum.doc: More live there than their room.

named.name: room
named.doc: How many live at one home content.

enum.name: OutOfPlace
enum.doc: The place is out of their niche.

enum.name: WrongElement
enum.doc: Its hearth's element isn't their nature.

named.name: hearth
named.doc: The hearth's element: 0 fire, 1 water, 2 wind, 3 earth.

types.name: PetView
types.doc:
Where some of a player's kept creatures are that aren't at its heel
(the `pets` query): one left where she settled, or a home of its own
with those homed there.

struct.name: species
struct.doc: The species: an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`.

struct.name: at
struct.doc: The cell she stands in; for a home, the home's block.

struct.name: homed
struct.doc: How many are homed there; 0 for one left out of a home.

types.name: TreeView
types.doc: A dryad tree as its heart panel shows it (the `tree` query).

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Who planted it.

struct.name: stage
struct.doc: Its growth stage: 0 is the sapling.

struct.name: bars
struct.doc: Each element's bar, as in `TreeInfo::bars`: never past `full`.

struct.name: notches
struct.doc:
The three notches of every bar, lowest first: a bar reaching one
ripens that branch's fruit for it.

struct.name: full
struct.doc: A full bar: it eats no more of its mana.

struct.name: health
struct.doc:
Its health, a line: below 1 it heals first, from all the mana it
eats, and its bars wait.

struct.name: buds
struct.doc:
Which fruit cells hold their bud, a bit each (`3 × branch +
notch`; bit 12 the crown, FX1: the fruit high on the trunk that
ripens once all four bars pass the last notch's way to full).

struct.name: ripe
struct.doc: Which hold their ripe fruit, a bit each.

struct.name: eaten
struct.doc: Which fruit have been eaten, a bit each (none yet).

struct.name: next
struct.doc:
The step its next fruit ripens, its bars fill, or its health heals,
at the rates now; none if nothing is coming.

struct.name: mana
struct.doc: Each element's mana item, the one its bar eats from the pools.

struct.name: fruit
struct.doc:
Each fruit's ripe block, by bit: what a notch ripens (the crown's
thirteenth, when the content has one).

struct.name: reach
struct.doc:
How far its land reaches at its stage, in blocks across the ground
from the heart, at every height (0 for none): inside it only the
owner and those it trusts build, break, use storages and work
machines (a column two lands share is the nearer heart's).

struct.name: trusted
struct.doc: Whom the owner trusts in its land, by name, sorted.

struct.name: appetite
struct.doc:
Its appetite's ceiling (PG3): the most a bar eats a step. Below
it a bar eats what its pool's wells bring past the frames on that
pool, so a bar's `rate` against this says how much more the base
could feed it.

struct.name: keeps
struct.doc:
What it leaves in each pool it eats from (PG3: a carving's cost),
so the runeforge on that pool can always carve.

struct.name: crown
struct.doc:
The crown's mark (FX1): its fruit (bit 12 of `buds`, `ripe` and
`eaten`, the 13th of `fruit`) ripens once every bar is past it, so
a panel says what each bar still needs. Zero for a tree with no
crown.

struct.name: crowns
struct.doc:
Every crown fruit's mark, in order (FX3): the first is `crown`'s,
a later one (the tide fruit) bit `12 + i` of `buds`, `ripe` and
`eaten` and the `13 + i`th of `fruit`, over the one before. Empty
for a tree with no crown.

types.name: PoolView
types.doc: A pool of mana as its panel shows it (the `pool` query).

struct.name: element
struct.doc: Its element: it holds that mana and nothing else.

struct.name: mana
struct.doc: Its element's mana item.

struct.name: amount
struct.doc:
The mana in it, a line from its last solve: a client reads it at
its clock, capped at `cap` and floored at 0, and glows the pool by
it with no message until a rate changes.

struct.name: cap
struct.doc: What it holds at most.

struct.name: in_rate
struct.doc: Mana a step its wells draw into it.

struct.name: out_rate
struct.doc: Mana a step eaten out of it (by dryad hearts).

struct.name: users
struct.doc:
The wells drawing into it and the hearts eating from it, by
position.

types.name: PoolUser
types.doc:
A well drawing into a pool, or a heart eating from it
(`PoolView::users`).

struct.name: pos
struct.doc: The well or heart.

struct.name: eats
struct.doc: A heart eating (true) or a well drawing (false).

struct.name: level
struct.doc:
How fast, a level 0..=7 (`forge_core::mana::rate_level`): 0 none,
else 1 + floor(log2) of its mana a minute, rounded up; an
uncrowded well's 10 a minute is 4.

types.name: FrameView
types.doc: A rune frame as its panel shows it (the `frame` query).

struct.name: name
struct.doc: Its template's name in `frames.json` (`ward_5`).

struct.name: size
struct.doc: 3 or 5 blocks across.

struct.name: rotation
struct.doc: Quarter turns clockwise.

struct.name: origin
struct.doc: Its north-west corner.

struct.name: key
struct.doc: Its key: its lowest block, where its stage is.

struct.name: sockets
struct.doc: Each socket's word by name, in socket order (none: blank).

struct.name: reads
struct.doc:
What it reads, in sentence order: its when (if any), element,
action (if any) and shape (if any), its basic job filling in what
its sockets leave out.

struct.name: fizzles
struct.doc: The words that dropped out, with why.

struct.name: rate
struct.doc:
Mana a step it spends from its pool (a ward, a circle) or its well
draws into it (a well frame), from its last solve.

struct.name: pool
struct.doc: Its pool (a well frame's: its well's), if it reaches one.

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Who finished it.

struct.name: delay
struct.doc:
Steps its night is held back by (its own delay, so frames don't
all turn on one step).

types.name: Fizzled
types.doc: A word that dropped out of a frame's sentence (`FrameView::fizzles`).

struct.name: word
struct.doc: The word's name in `words.json` (`hold`).

types.name: Fizzle
types.doc:
Why a word a frame holds drops out of its sentence
(`forge_core::rune::Fizzle`).

enum.name: Twice
enum.doc: A second word of a kind the sentence already has.

enum.name: NotHere
enum.doc: This frame doesn't take it.

enum.name: NotYet
enum.doc: This frame takes it in a later season.

enum.name: WrongElement
enum.doc: Its element isn't the frame's (a well's core).

types.name: FrameStatus
types.doc: What a frame does now (`FrameView::status`).

enum.name: Running
enum.doc: Spending (or drawing) all it asks.

enum.name: Dim
enum.doc:
Spending only this much of what it asks, in thousandths: its pool
ran dry and its users share what comes in.

enum.name: NotNow
enum.doc: Waiting for its when.

enum.name: NoPool
enum.doc: No pool of its element along its lines.

enum.name: Idle
enum.doc: It does nothing: no job, or no drive for its well.

enum.name: Empty
enum.doc:
A bed with nothing on its slab it can work, a hearth with no fed
creature in its home.

enum.name: Full
enum.doc: A bed whose slab is full.

enum.name: NoStore
enum.doc:
A carrying bed with nowhere to take what it holds: no storage
along its lines, or none that takes it.

enum.name: StoreFull
enum.doc: A carrying bed whose storage is full.

types.name: When
types.doc: A word's *when* (`forge_core::rune::When`).

enum.name: AtNight
enum.doc: Only at night, each frame's night held back by its own delay.

enum.name: WhenFull
enum.doc: Only while its pool is full.

types.name: FramesView
types.doc:
The rune frames and pools of one section, as a client draws them (the
`frames` query).

struct.name: frames
struct.doc: The frames whose corner is in the section, by corner.

struct.name: pools
struct.doc: The pools in it, by position.

struct.name: lines
struct.doc:
The lines of those frames to their pools, then the lines of the
section's pools to their plain wells and hearts (no frame's).

types.name: FrameGlow
types.doc: A frame as a client draws its glow (`FramesView::frames`).

struct.name: origin
struct.doc: Its north-west corner.

struct.name: frame
struct.doc: Its template, by index in `frames.json`.

struct.name: rotation
struct.doc: Quarter turns clockwise.

struct.name: level
struct.doc: How bright, 0 (dark) to 7 (all it asks).

struct.name: armed
struct.doc: True while it spends (or draws).

struct.name: fizzled
struct.doc:
Its sockets whose words fizzled, a bit a socket in socket order (the
`frame` query's `sockets`): a client sparks each in its word's
colour.

types.name: PoolGlow
types.doc: A pool as a client draws its fill (`FramesView::pools`).

struct.name: amount
struct.doc:
The mana in it, a line from its last solve: read it at the clock,
capped at `cap` and floored at 0.

struct.name: cap
struct.doc: What it holds at most.

types.name: LineRate
types.doc:
Mana running along a rune line between a pool and a frame
(`FramesView::lines`), for the motes.

struct.name: user
struct.doc: The frame's key (a well frame's: its well).

struct.name: into
struct.doc: Into the pool (a well frame) or out of it (a ward, a circle).

struct.name: level
struct.doc: How fast, a level 0..=7 (`forge_core::mana::rate_level`).

types.name: RuneforgeView
types.doc: A runeforge as its panel shows it (the `runeforge` query, RW3).

struct.name: standing
struct.doc:
True while its frame stands round the forge stone (it carves and
charges only then).

struct.name: pools
struct.doc:
The nearest usable pool of each element along its lines, where it
has one: what a carving and a charge spend from.

struct.name: slot
struct.doc: The tool charging, if any.

struct.name: stall
struct.doc:
Why the charging is stopped, if it is: no pool of the tool's
element (`NoInput`), full (`OutputBlocked`), or its frame broken
(`Incomplete`).

struct.name: sockets
struct.doc:
How many words a charm set here holds (RW3b): 1 an action alone, 2
an action and a shape. Grows with the stage of the tree whose land
holds the forge stone.

types.name: ForgePool
types.doc: A runeforge's pool of one element (`RuneforgeView::pools`).

struct.name: usable
struct.doc:
Whether the asking player may spend from it: it is in land that
player may work (`World::forge_pool_usable`, the check a make that
costs mana passes). A client counts only such a pool's mana.

types.name: ChargeSlotView
types.doc: The tool in a runeforge's charge slot (`RuneforgeView::slot`).

struct.name: id
struct.doc: Its instance id.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The tool.

struct.name: rune
struct.doc: Its rune by name in `words.json` (`heat`).

struct.name: element
struct.doc: Its rune's element: the pool it charges from.

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Who put it in: only they take it out.

struct.name: charge
struct.doc:
Its charge as a line: a client reads it at its clock, capped at
`cap`, and draws it rising with no message until a rate changes.

struct.name: cap
struct.doc: The most charge it holds.

struct.name: words
struct.doc:
All its words by name, in order (a charm's sentence: its action,
then its shape; RW3b).

types.name: ToolView
types.doc:
A rune tool in the asker's inventory (the `tools` query, RW3): one item
with its own rune and charge, never stacked.

struct.name: id
struct.doc: Its instance id.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The tool.

struct.name: rune
struct.doc: Its rune by name in `words.json` (`heat`).

struct.name: charge
struct.doc: Its charge, whole units.

struct.name: cap
struct.doc: The most charge it holds.

struct.name: words
struct.doc:
All its words by name, in order (a charm's sentence: its action,
then its shape; RW3b).

struct.name: charm
struct.doc:
A forged charm's cast (RW3b), its shape word applied: what a charm
slot does with it. Its `charge` is the charge one cast spends.
`None` for a tool, or a charm with no action set.

struct.name: power
struct.doc:
What its rune does in the tool while it holds charge (RW4); `None`
for a charm, a tool with no rune, or one whose rune does nothing
there. A client honours it only while `charge` is above 0, as the
server does: dry, the tool works as its plain self.

types.name: ToolPower
types.doc:
What a rune does in a plain tool while it holds charge (RW4,
`forge_core::rune::ToolRune`; a word's `"tool"` in `words.json`).

enum.name: Smelts
enum.doc:
*heat*: a break falls smelted, as the ember pick's does; each break
it smelts spends a charge.

enum.name: Reach
enum.doc:
*crush*: takes the block behind too, as the mattock does; each block
behind spends a charge.

enum.name: Glides
enum.doc:
*lift*: held, it glides, as the glider does; each glide spends a
charge when it ends.

enum.name: Breathes
enum.doc:
*breathe* (a relic's word, SP4): held, the eye under water loses no
air; a charge every 10 s it holds the air.

enum.name: Echoes
enum.doc:
*echo* (a relic's word, SP4): a block it breaks pings the ore
within 6 blocks (`ServerMsg::Echo`); a charge a ping that finds
some.

enum.name: Cushions
enum.doc:
*float* (a relic's word, SP4): held, a fall that would hurt
doesn't; a charge a fall it takes.

enum.name: Sweeps
enum.doc:
*tide* (the guardian's word, SP5): a break it makes in ore takes
the rest of the vein touching it, up to 12 blocks more; a charge a
vein.

types.name: ScrollView
types.doc:
A rune scroll in the asker's inventory (the `scrolls` query, RW6): a
frame written down, which a client projects as ghost cells to build
by (docs/engine/runes-scrolls.md).

struct.name: id
struct.doc: Its instance id.

struct.name: text
struct.doc: Its line, as a player copies it (`fw1:ward3/fire.burn.ring`).

struct.name: frame
struct.doc: Its frame's template name in `frames.json` (`ward_3`).

struct.name: words
struct.doc: Each socket's word by name in template order, `""` for a blank.

types.name: KinCardView
types.doc:
A kin of the asking player's who could be a companion, as the kin
panel shows her (the `kin` query, KN3).

struct.name: herd
struct.doc: Her herd (as `EntityKind::Kept::herd`).

struct.name: member
struct.doc: Her place in it.

struct.name: species
struct.doc: Her species (an index into `ContentInfo.creatures`).

struct.name: party
struct.doc: She follows now (one of the party's three).

struct.name: resting_until
struct.doc: Knocked out, she rests at home until this step (world time).

struct.name: bond
struct.doc: Her bond at `at`, in thousandths of full (the card's bar).

struct.name: at
struct.doc: The step `bond` is as of (world time).

struct.name: full_at
struct.doc:
The step her bond is full at as things are (world time; linear
from `at`), if it isn't yet.

struct.name: words
struct.doc:
Her words: the active (the kit's button), the passive (always on
while she follows) and the second (a full bond's); a cleansed Spire
native has a fourth, her family's (KN5).

struct.name: cosmetic
struct.doc: The look a full bond earns her ("Kindled").

struct.name: hearth
struct.doc: Her hearth: the home she lives at, or left to follow.

struct.name: mana_now
struct.doc: Mana a minute, in tenths, her hearth makes now (fed).

struct.name: mana_then
struct.doc:
Mana a minute, in tenths, it would make the other way: without
her if she is home, with her back if she follows.

struct.name: birthplace
struct.doc:
Her birthplace variant (KN6, so the card names her as her nameplate
does when she is out of sight): as `Kept`'s, 0 for none, else 1 + an
index into her species' `birthplaces`.

struct.name: traits
struct.doc: Her traits (KN6): as `Kept`'s, bit `i` is `ContentInfo.traits[i]`.

struct.name: homed
struct.doc:
How many live at her hearth now (FX1; 0 with no hearth): more than
`room` and it is crowded, its kin sulking at half the rate.

struct.name: room
struct.doc: How many of her species live at one home content (its `room`).

struct.name: rejoins
struct.doc:
Knocked out while she followed, she comes back to the party by
herself once rested (EV6a-3, appended): false once her owner
takes her along, sends her home or moves her to another home.

types.name: KinWordView
types.doc: One of a kin's words as her card shows it (KN3).

struct.name: label
struct.doc: Its name for players ("Heat").

struct.name: about
struct.doc: What it does, a line.

struct.name: unlocked
struct.doc: Hers now (the second needs a full bond).

types.name: StoneView
types.doc:
A standing stone placed near spawn (the `stones` query, RW9): an
ancient rune frame a player copies with a scroll.

struct.name: name
struct.doc: Its feature's name in the world settings (`light_stone`).

struct.name: at
struct.doc: The cell over the ground at its frame's centre.

types.name: RelicView
types.doc:
A Spire relic in the asker's inventory (the `relics` query, SP4;
docs/engine/spire-relics.md): rolled words sealed in a broken thing,
broken at a runeforge (`Command::BreakRelic`) into its words' items.
Its card shows its first word; the rest stay sealed until it breaks.

struct.name: id
struct.doc: Its instance id.

struct.name: item
struct.doc: Its kind (a broken charm, a cracked tool, a world core).

struct.name: quality
struct.doc: Its quality: 0 cracked, 1 worn, 2 whole. It holds one word more.

struct.name: quality_name
struct.doc: The quality's name (`cracked`).

struct.name: floor
struct.doc: The floor it came from (1 up).

struct.name: floor_title
struct.doc: That floor's name (`The Sluices`).

struct.name: shown
struct.doc: The word it shows, by name in `words.json` (`breathe`).

struct.name: sealed
struct.doc: How many more words it holds, sealed until it breaks.

types.name: AltarView
types.doc:
An altar (P5.1; the `altar` query): the list its owner's floor asks
for, what it holds of each line, and the keys forged into it. Things
are given with `Command::StoragePut` (a put past a line's need is cut
to it) and keys taken with `Command::StorageTake`.

struct.name: pos
struct.doc: Its altar stone.

struct.name: owner
struct.doc: Its owner's name.

struct.name: floor
struct.doc: The floor it forges keys for (1 to 4).

struct.name: offered
struct.doc: The floors its owner may choose: bit `n - 1` for floor `n`.

struct.name: lines
struct.doc: The list, its strange line first.

struct.name: reroll
struct.doc: What rerolling the list costs, in root shards: 0, free.

struct.name: keys
struct.doc:
The keys in it now (it holds at most four; a full altar takes
nothing until one is taken out).

struct.name: fed_by
struct.doc:
How many carrying beds' lines reach it (P5.2: a sort or carry
bed whose line ends at it brings what the list asks for).

struct.name: framed
struct.doc:
Whether its frame stands whole: an altar out of its frame forges
nothing.

struct.name: givers
struct.doc:
The last others who gave to it, newest first, by name (P5.2's
gifts: anyone may give what the list still asks for; only its
owner takes).

types.name: AltarLine
types.doc: One line of an altar's list ([`AltarView::lines`]).

struct.name: item
struct.doc: The item asked for.

struct.name: need
struct.doc: How many the list asks for.

struct.name: have
struct.doc: How many the altar holds.

struct.name: hint
struct.doc:
Where a player gets it, in a few words ("pull tall grass"), from
`altar.json`; empty where it says none (HL3).

queries.name: block
queries.doc:
The block at `pos` as a step timeline of block, facing, and growth
stage, from the current state on. A constant block is one step from
time 0; a compiled tree spot lists its cycle (sapling stages, felled,
replanted) one cycle ahead.

queries.name: inventory
queries.doc: The asking player's non-empty inventory slots, by slot index.

queries.name: position
queries.doc: The asking player's position.

queries.name: storage
queries.doc:
The storage (chest) at `pos` as linear amounts, or null if the block
there isn't one.

queries.name: machine
queries.doc:
The machine at `pos` (a well, a furnace, a crucible, a dryad heart):
running, idle, or stalled with a cause, and its rotor's spin (a big
well's); null if the block there isn't one.

queries.name: stats
queries.doc:
Engine counters for tests and diagnostics; any player may ask.
Recomputed after commands and scheduled events, not on every step of a
running clock.

queries.name: watch
queries.doc:
The chunks the asking player's body watches, in order: every chunk
within two of its own on each axis while it is connected. Factories
there run live.

queries.name: entities
queries.doc:
The live entities in the asking player's watched chunks, keyed by id.
A snapshot for bots and tools; renderers follow the entity stream
(`EntityStream`), which carries the same entities (velocities quantized)
without a subscription.

queries.name: basin
queries.doc:
The basin of water whose body holds `pos` (or whose id is `pos`): its
level and volume as linear timelines, its mode and flows, and its next
event; null if there is none.

queries.name: fluid_at
queries.doc:
Derived water at `pos`: whether the cell holds water, the flow through
it and its direction, the basin holding it, and whether it is a
converted river's channel.

queries.name: fluids
queries.doc:
The world's water balance now (stored + exited = sourced + adopted,
exactly), for tests and diagnostics. Recomputed after every batch of
changes.

queries.name: heat
queries.doc:
The heat at `pos`: the sum over burning furnaces within their radius
of their heat, falling off with distance. A crucible smelts an item
once it reaches its recipe's `min_heat`. Constant until a furnace is lit
or runs dry.

queries.name: weather_at
queries.doc:
The weather at block column `(x, z)` now, as the server computes it
(`forge_core::weather`) under the column's climate (or 12 °C and
moisture 50 without one); null if the world has no weather. For tests
and diagnostics: clients work the weather out from the fronts they are
sent. Rerun after every batch of changes, not as the clock runs.

queries.name: home
queries.doc:
The asking player's home: where a knockout wakes its body and a recall
(`Command::Recall`) brings it, its feet's position: beside its dryad
tree's heart once it has planted one, else the crash site. It moves
when the player plants, and when the blocks there change.

queries.name: satchels
queries.doc:
The asking player's satchels (the piles its knockouts left, which only
it takes), in the order the world keeps them. Updated when one is left,
taken, or swept, not as the body walks.

queries.name: elder
queries.doc:
The elder tree nearest the crash site: its trunk's middle, over the
ground there (see `forge_core::dryad::nearest_elder`), or none if the
world has none within reach. Where the opening sends a new player for the seed;
the same for every player, and it never changes.

queries.name: crash_site
queries.doc:
The crash site: the cell over the ground at the world's spawn point as
generated, where every new player wakes and a client draws the wreck.
The same for every player, and it never changes.

queries.name: wreck
queries.doc:
The wreck (L3): where it lies by the crash site (the same for every
player, and it never moves), and the asking player's share of its
salvage: pulls taken, and pulls left today. Updated when the player
salvages and when the next game day brings a pull.

queries.name: kept_home
queries.doc:
The creature home at `pos` (W9): its species, owner and fit, who lives
there (the young with when they grow up), what it gives and has made,
whether it is fed or stalled and why, and when its next product and
next birth are (or why none is coming); null if no home is there (a
home block nobody has homed a creature at yet).

queries.name: pets
queries.doc:
Where the asking player's kept creatures are that aren't at its heel:
each left where she settled (out of reach when it went home, or left
behind), and each of its homes with how many are homed there, in herd
order. Updated when one is tamed, settled, homed or unhomed, and when
one starts or stops following, not as they walk.

queries.name: tree
queries.doc:
The dryad tree whose heart is at `pos`, as its heart panel shows it:
its bars and their notches, its health, which fruit are budded and
ripe, and when the next ripens; null if no tree's heart is there. A
client asks only while the panel is open. Rerun when the tree changes
(a solve of its heart that changes a rate, a ripening) or a fruit's
block does, not as the bars rise.

queries.name: pool
queries.doc:
The pool of mana at `pos`, as its panel and the Seer's lens show it:
its element, its amount as a line (a client glows it from this alone),
its cap, the rates in and out, and the wells drawing into it and the
hearts eating from it with their levels 0..=7; null if no pool is
there. Rerun when its factory is solved (a rate changes), not as it
fills.

queries.name: frame
queries.doc:
The rune frame owning the block at `pos` (any of its stones, sockets
or core), as its panel shows it: its template, words, what it reads
and which words fizzled with why, what it does now, its rate and its
pool; null if no frame owns that block. Rerun when its factory is
solved or its blocks change, not as its pool drains.

queries.name: frames
queries.doc:
The rune frames and pools of the section holding `pos`, as a client
draws their glow and motes: each frame's level 0..=7 and whether it is
armed, each pool's fill as a line, and each frame's line to its pool.
Ask with the section's lowest corner, so everyone watching it shares
one computation. Rerun when a solve or an edit marks the section.

queries.name: runeforge
queries.doc:
The runeforge whose forge stone is at `pos`, as its panel shows it
(RW3): whether its frame stands, its nearest pool of each element, the
tool in its charge slot with its charge as a line (a client draws it
rising from this alone), and why charging stopped; null if no forge
stone or charge slot is there. Each pool says whether the asking
player may spend from it (its land is one the player may work: a make
that costs mana spends only from such a pool). Rerun when the slot or
its frame changes, or who may work a pool's land, not as the tool
fills.

queries.name: tools
queries.doc:
The asking player's rune tools (RW3), by slot index: each one's rune,
whole charge and cap. Empty while it holds none.

queries.name: scrolls
queries.doc:
The asking player's rune scrolls (RW6), by slot index: each one's line,
frame and words. Empty while it holds none.

queries.name: kin
queries.doc:
The asking player's kin who could be companions (KN3), as the kin
panel's cards: who follows now (at most three), each one's bond (a bar
that fills linearly to `full_at`), words, look, and her hearth's mana a
minute now and the other way. Updated as one joins, leaves, is knocked
out or bonds, and when a bond fills or a rest ends.

queries.name: stones
queries.doc:
The standing stones placed near spawn (RW9): each one's name in the
world settings (`light_stone`, a rune wonder) and the cell over the
ground at its frame's centre, nearest spawn first; empty for a world
without them. The compass marks the nearest a player hasn't read. The
same for every player, and it never changes.

queries.name: relics
queries.doc:
The asking player's Spire relics (SP4), by slot index: each one's
kind, quality, floor and the word it shows (the rest sealed until it
breaks at a runeforge: `Command::BreakRelic`). Empty while it holds
none.

queries.name: altar
queries.doc:
The altar whose stone is at `pos`, as its panel shows it (P5.1): its
owner, the floor it forges keys for and the floors offered, the list
with what it holds of each line, a reroll's cost, its keys and whether
its frame stands; null if no live altar is there. Rerun when its
storage, its blocks or its owner change.

queries.name: home_by_tree
queries.doc:
Whether the asking player's home (the `home` query) is by its own
dryad tree (true) or the crash site, by the wreck (false): no tree yet,
or every cell beside its heart built over, so no room to stand there.
What the compass and the recall call home. Rerun with `home`.
